samples.text_head: Net Asset Value(s) | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Net Asset Value(s) AI Summary Close X Aberforth Smaller Companies Trust reported NAVs per ordinary share at close of business on 18 November 2026 of 2,007.09p excluding current-year revenue and 2,059.00p including all revenue (a current-year revenue contribution of 51.91p). With 75,242,105 shares in issue the including-revenue NAV implies shareholders' funds of about £1,549m. The trust has bank facilities permitting gearing up to 8.4% of shareholders' funds versus current gearing of 6.1%, leaving roughly 2.3 percentage points of additional leverage capacity (about £35.6m of borrowing headroom).
